name: Cycle of Rebirth
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield seeks Gaea seeds to help heal Stonetalon. She asks the Horde to gather the rare seeds from Mirkfallon Lake, hoping to bless them and restore the mountain’s damaged soil.

sections.title: A Scarred Wilderness
sections.body: Stonetalon’s peaks bear wounds from commercial exploitation and regional conflict. Logging and clashes between rival factions have left forests scorched, cut down, or reduced to ash. For the tauren stationed at Sun Rock Retreat, the rapid destruction of the natural world is a grievous wound. Shamans like Tammra Windfield seek the Earthmother’s restorative cycle as they work to mend the land.

sections.title: The Seeds of Mirkfallon
sections.body: Tammra seeks rare Gaea seeds around Mirkfallon Lake, north of Sun Rock Retreat. The lake’s banks nurture sturdy seed pods along the water’s edge. These seeds have a resilience unique to Stonetalon, though danger surrounds the region. Once they are gathered, Tammra channels ancestral shamanistic blessings into each kernel, awakening its power to speed its growth.

faq.q: What is the purpose of collecting Gaea seeds?
faq.answer: Gaea seeds have the vitality Tammra Windfield seeks for restoring damaged land. She gathers them to bless with the Earthmother’s power, preparing them to sprout quickly and replenish parts of Stonetalon ruined by industry and war.

faq.q: Where are the Gaea seeds located?
faq.answer: Gaea seeds lie along Mirkfallon Lake’s shoreline, north of Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. They can be found in the dirt near the water’s edge around the lake.
Tammra Windfield is a tauren shaman at Sun Rock Retreat. Logging and wartime conflict have devastated Stonetalon, and she works to heal the land with Earthmother blessings.

faq.q: What does Tammra do once the seeds are returned?
faq.answer: When Tammra receives the ten Gaea seeds, she chants to infuse them with shamanistic energy and quicken their growth, preparing them for planting in devastated places.

faq.q: What quest follows Cycle of Rebirth?
aliases: next quest after cycle of rebirth
what is after cycle of rebirth
faq.answer: Cycle of Rebirth leads to New Life, when the blessed seeds are carried into the devastated Charred Vale to begin restoring plant life.

faq.q: Why is the land of Stonetalon in need of healing?
faq.answer: The Stonetalon Mountains have suffered damage from warfare and extensive clear-cutting by industrial lumber ventures. Scorched wastelands and scarred valleys struggle to regrow naturally.

angles.text: Tammra’s work reflects the shamanic calling to mend ecological imbalance. The spirits and the Earthmother can restore what industrial exploitation tears down.
For the Shu'halo, healing Stonetalon’s wounded soil is a spiritual duty to the Earthmother, answering the damage caused by reckless logging and factional warfare.
Druids may recognize the focus on natural cycles and seed cultivation. Restoring barren earth echoes Cenarion stewardship.
